label: The 14-skill count is correct for a clone: git ls-tree HEAD lists 14 skill directories (identical to the v4.0.2.1 tree), and the 15th working-tree directory .skilled/skills/local-webflow is an untracked symlink to an operator path outside the repository

Every 14-skills claim in the current README is accurate and must not be raised to 15 (README.md:226, README.md:801, README.md:1689); this is the third untracked-operator count trap in the run after iteration 6's 45-command count and iteration 10's gitignored Pi entries

The catalog's silence on local-webflow is deliberate: README.md:835 already defines the operator-private surface skill concept and describes it inside the sk-code entry rather than as a shipped 15th entry

The section 9 SKILL LIBRARY is a complete one-to-one map of the 14 tracked skills with no missing and no phantom entry, so its 50.6 percent share of the file is a verbosity problem rather than an inventory problem; system-deep-loop and cli-orca use non-standard placements that would break a naive bold-heading count

Skill delivery takes four forms across eight runtimes: .claude/.devin/.opencode/.pi skills are each a single tracked directory symlink to ../.skilled/skills; .dsh and .vibe skills are real directories of 55 tracked per-entry symlinks; .codex and .cursor have no skills surface at all, using prompts and commands instead

The 55 entries in each flattened mirror decompose exactly into 14 tracked skills plus 41 hub mode directories (9 cli-* bridges, deep-research, deep-review, 8 mcp-* modes, 5 sk-code-* surfaces, 14 sk-create-* modes, 3 sk-design-* modes), reconciling with no remainder

/doctor:runtime-mirrors inspects skill mirrors only for DSH and Vibe, the two runtimes whose per-entry links can drift individually; the README describes it as checking agent, command, prompt and hook mirrors and omits skills, so the rewrite should say it checks every mirror that can drift rather than listing surfaces

The Codex prompt and Cursor command mirrors carry the same untracked-operator surplus as the skill count: 46 on disk against 44 tracked and 47 against 45 tracked, with the 45 matching iteration 6's settled command count, so a rewrite quoting 46 or 47 would overstate the public tree

A skill count quoted in a README must be verified with git ls-files or git ls-tree, never with ls: an operator symlink resolving into .skilled/skills inflates the on-disk count while remaining absent from the index

A mirror that is a single directory symlink cannot partially drift, so a drift checker need not inspect it; only per-entry link mirrors need a check, which is why the doctor command covers DSH and Vibe skills and not the four directory-link runtimes

.skilled/skills/local-webflow resolves to /Users/michelkerkmeester/MEGA/Development/Websites/A. Nobel & Zn./local-skills/local-webflow, a path outside the repository, and git check-ignore refuses it with a pathspec-beyond-a-symbolic-link error rather than reporting an ignore rule

progressiveSynthesis is true in deep-research-config.json while the dispatch allowed-write list names only iterations/iteration-015.md and deltas/iter-015.jsonl, so the research.md synthesis edit was refused for the fifth consecutive iteration
